about: Owed from Brief 120 (review F11): a held-out wet case for system capacity, chosen before any run and not used to set anything. Brief 120's referee (120_plant_spec.json) at different water temperatures, radiator sizes and capacity: flow 70 C, return 50 C (120: 50/40), unequal radiators 1,500 W west and 700 W east (120: 1,100/1,100 and 1,600/900), plant 1,300 W (120: 1,600 and 2,600). Exponent 1 and all convective, because EnergyPlus's water baseboard is effectiveness-NTU at a fixed UA, which is exponent 1: the review's n = 1.3 cannot be represented in EnergyPlus, so it is not refereed here. Two heated rooms, because the cooled room's middle room is cooled; a third heated room would change 104's referee model. Same gate as 120.

gate.note: As 120_plant_spec.json: per room, annual heating within +/-3 %; unmet hours within +/-10 % or +/-10 h, whichever is larger. Shares in the plant's short hours reported, not gated.

added_after_first_run: heldout_free (the same radiators, a plant far above any ask) was added after the first run missed the heating gate by 0.2-0.4 points, to attribute the miss to the plant or to the rooms; it is reported, and the first result stands as reported.
